description: AI action bar of the translation card (2.1.0): which chips show for a source language, the follow-up presets, the instructions of the two new actions, the material block sent as user text, the follow-up conversation (native multi-turn messages, and the flattened single text for providers without multi-turn), and the source badge. The guard sentence is also appended as the last line of every reading-lens and sentence-structure instruction.
